doc_summary: `native_spread_players_teleport(dimension, entity, player, from, target, cancel)`, once per entity (`player` is the UUID of a player, None for any other) `/spreadplayers` is about to place, after the spread worked out its spot. A mod may move `target` (a value that is not a number is ignored). Set `cancel` to leave that entity where it is; the other entities, the random draws and the feedback are unchanged. Server-side. Bundles need "hooks": @API:spread_players_teleport@.
